description: This file contains Armenian localization strings for the Select2 plugin version 4.0.6-rc.1.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message indicating that results cannot be loaded.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to remove excess characters.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to input more characters.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns a message indicating more results are loading.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of selections allowed.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns a message indicating no search results were found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a search is in progress.
